import pandas as pd
def clean(df):
    df = df.drop_duplicates(keep='first')
    numeric_cols = ['flipper_length_mm', 'body_mass_g', 'year']
    for col in numeric_cols:
        df[col] = pd.to_numeric(df[col], errors='coerce')
    allowed_species = ["Adelie", "Chinstrap", "Gentoo"]
    allowed_islands = ["Biscoe", "Dream", "Torgersen"]
    df['species'] = df['species'].str.title()
    df['species'] = df['species'].where(df['species'].isin(allowed_species), pd.NA)
    df['island'] = df['island'].str.title()
    df['island'] = df['island'].where(df['island'].isin(allowed_islands), pd.NA)
    mask = (df['flipper_length_mm'] < 170) | (df['flipper_length_mm'] > 235)
    df.loc[mask, 'flipper_length_mm'] = pd.NA
    return df

def answer(df):
    grouped = df.groupby('island').size().to_dict()
    return grouped
